result:
Clean. Implementation summary:

- Scaffolded a local Expo module (`modules/expo-health`, iOS-only) wrapping HealthKit directly in Swift — authorization status/request, saving a step-count sample, and a 7-day daily step query via `HKStatisticsCollectionQuery`.
- Added `NSHealthShareUsageDescription`/`NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription` and the `com.apple.developer.healthkit` entitlement to `app.json`.
- Wired `HealthScreen.tsx` to the module per §4: status line reflects share-authorization state (refreshed on every mount, since `App.tsx` unmounts/remounts screens on navigation), `Log 500 Steps` enabled only when granted, and the Last 7 Days list renders exactly 7 rows (most-recent first, today emphasized and suffixed) or `Health access needed` when not granted, with errors surfaced in the status line.
- `npx expo prebuild --platform ios && xcodebuild ... build` succeeds with no errors or warnings from the new module.
